Try it:

The world is the screen

No columns. The scene fills the frame, and the chrome is a few small glass controls that sit over it.

Thinking happens above him

Reasoning streams in a thought cloud over Steve and fades into a trail. His replies to you use a different shape. Tap a bubble to read it all.

Everything else is behind a tab

Goal, Self, Log and Debug share one panel on the right rail. Chat is a drawer. Run controls collapse to one transport bar.

Build is a mode

The same world with the docks swapped: a tool rail, a thumbnail palette, an overview map and Apply.

The two world frames, piece thumbnails and overview map come from your real build. Thoughts, tasks, log lines and Self content are illustrative sample text.
